name: io.github.User0856/snaprender
description: Screenshot, extract content, and render web pages via the SnapRender API. Capture any URL as PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF with device emulation, dark mode, ad/cookie blocking. Extract page content as markdown, text, or metadata. Batch process up to 50 URLs. Generate signed URLs for client-side embedding. Render raw HTML or Markdown to images.

environmentVariables.name: SNAPRENDER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your SnapRender API key (starts with sk_live_). Get one free at https://snap-render.com/auth/signup
